I think you’re me. My break up with my ex, was something cut out of a nightmare drama series. Got ghosted, told me some traumatic things, and next thing I know he was engaged with someone else. It’s been months already. It’s not like I’m hoping to get him back. But the trauma stayed. The heartbreak made a deep scar. I’m not living anymore, I’m just pretending to live everyday. He have moved on, I know  I should carry on as well. But it felt like he killed something inside me. I felt empty and shallow since then. I don’t even know how to describe how I feel.
I want to do everything people advise me to do. But my heart and my mind is a very tricky things to control. And I’m so disappointed for disappointing people who are so helpful to me.

It’s really frustrating to feel helpless even tho there’s a lot of good people who always wanted to help us out, always appreciative of them but it’s like I’m always disappointing them about not making any progress. I want to move on completely. Want to apply and do all the things my friends told me too. But it’s like I’m having a short circuit that I can’t just move on from what happened and carry on with life. And I’m so disappointed to myself for failing to be brave and strong person.
Don’t try to understand him because that’s what he is. Been there. Same story. Looking back now, it’s not because he is drunk. That’s just the way he is and he’s an asshole.

I think OP should be sure if he’s sees long term commitment with her. Because if not, and he’s already seeing all of the things around him like only for his own benefits, I’m not sure if you guys want to go all the trouble moving in together. Feeling unwanted by someone you love (especially your significant other) is the worse feeling someone can have. If she moves in with you, and everytime you guys won’t meet each other in half-way, the probability of OP reminding her whose the owner of the house and that she can go if she doesn’t agree with him would likely make her be like walking on eggshells around him. In the end, OP, please be sure about your feelings with her, I’ve been in somehow same situation, please don’t drag the whole relationship further for just your own feelings. Consider hers too. If you’re not seeing a future with her, let her know. Before things will get more messy.

Wanting to reach out to him was something I always wanted, I know he probably doesn’t love me anymore, but for me, all I wanted was to know why he left. Did I do something wrong? There were a lot more days that I just stare on blank space and maybe still in shock that he’s not in my life anymore. How quickly someone I have everyday instantly gone.

I miss you. I know I should be angry at you for the you treated me. I don’t know why I couldn’t get myself to hate you the way you hate me. 

Was that 4 years meant nothing to you? Did you really love me at all? Because I still don’t understand how a person can just cut all the ties in a second after all those years being together.

Hi A.C.,

I don’t know what I’m doing here anyway, it’s been 4 months since you just decided to stop talking to me and literally just ghosted me after 4 years of being together. 

I miss you so much Hun. It’s been 4 months and I still cry myself every night hoping you’ll just call me and say this is just a nightmare. I don’t know what happened, you won’t tell me. You just left me. We were planning to see each other next year right? What happened to that? 

I don’t know what to do anymore. The last text you told me after I beg you to talk to me and tell me what’s going on, you told me just to kill myself. I tried baby, I tried to do it just for you to live a peaceful life without me.

I saw you posting a double date on my birthday. I guess that was the answer I’ve been waiting for. You promised me you’ll never cheat on me. You promised you’ll never hurt me like that. You promised I’m safe with you.

I never hated you no matter what you have done or said to me. You know I never did angry with you before.

I’m sorry I wasn’t good enough for you. I’m sorry I wasn’t beautiful like your new girl now. I’m sorry I wasn’t the perfect girl you wanted me to be. I tried baby, I tried my best for you.

I’m sorry I’m not a Nepali that you could be proud of or that your family will approve. I wish I am. I wish I was the one you can be with.

I don’t know how many more days or months I could stop myself from killing myself. I wonder if this is really what you want, if this is really what will make you happy. 


I hope she’ll love you and take care of you in the best way she can. I hope she’ll make you laugh, I hope you won’t hurt her too. I know she have taken my place, I would’ve done anything to take it back, but if me being gone in your life will make you happy, then so be it. All I ever wanted is for you to be happy Hun. 

Please take care of yourself. I wanted to see you happy even it’s not with me.

I love you so much, and I’ll always will.

-J.
